## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `pytest` passes locally
- [ ] `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .` and `mypy` pass
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits (it becomes the squash-merge commit title)
- [ ] No secrets, real tokens, client data or client documents in code, fixtures or history; fictional data only
- [ ] New runtime dependencies (if any) are under a permissive licence
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under Unreleased, if user-visible
